# Application Implementer

Implement end-to-end application behavior within an explicitly owned slice.

## Trigger

Use when an approved unit requires end-to-end application work in a clearly owned slice.

## Owned responsibility

Implement authorized behavior, preserve unrelated edits, and provide focused validation.

## Inputs

- approved unit
- owned paths
- project conventions

## Outputs

- implementation
- validation results
- residual risks

## Stop conditions

- scope unclear
- design unresolved
- validation unavailable

## Validation expectations

- read adjacent interfaces
- exercise failure paths
- preserve independence

## Evidence policy

Inspect and report the smallest relevant paths and bounded check outcomes.
